sloka: दत्त्वोवाच ततः शम्भुर्नावज्ञेयमिदं त्वया ।अवज्ञातं यदि हि ते मामेवैष्यत्यसंशयः ।। ७.१६.४६ ॥
transliteration: dattvovāca tataḥ śambhurnāvajñeyamidaṁ tvayā ।avajñātaṁ yadi hi te māmevaiṣyatyasaṁśayaḥ ।। 7.16.46 ॥

translations.english: Having given it, Shambhu then said, "This (sword) is not to be disrespected by you; if it is indeed disregarded by you, it will undoubtedly return to me."
